bio:
Benjamin Pringle (24 Jan 1794 - 6 Jan 1853) married Charity Gould (b. 1800, granddaughter of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreaux) Davenport). His 1853 PA death and burial record names 'Sam Pringle & Martha'. Children: Bethia (m. Caleb Roberts 1852, Iowa), Martha Ann (m. William Hutchinson), Lege (1825), Ira (1833), Jacob Gould (m. (1) VanScoy, (2) the widow Ellen C. (Fuller) Nesbitt, 1864), Martin (California) and Caleb (b. 1839, 'went West'). Proves Benjamin was one of Samuel and Martha's five sons.

In the 1840 census of Plymouth Twp, 'Benjn Pringle' heads a household of about ten, a few lines above Saml Pringle and James Pringle ([R4-S2]). The age column for the head reads 50-60, which is older than his 1794 birth date suggests. FamilySearch attaches a Minnesota death record of his daughter Bethia (Pringle) Roberts naming 'Benj. Pringle' as her father, which extends the 'Bethia, Iowa' line in the existing bio, and gives his burial at Larksville ([R4-S1]).
sources: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) pp.280-281

[R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, Benjamin Pringle (L7XP-VKX), citing Minnesota County Deaths (daughter Bethia Roberts) and Pennsylvania Deaths and Burials (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/L7XP-VKX
